demo.cliff: the other half of a type
teaches: subType: loot is the item type's default, and it is what the type is for when nothing about software applies.
quantity above 1 is how a stack is carried: weight and cost are per unit, and the sheet multiplies.
container.id is where a stack says which bag it is in — the id of a container Item on the same Actor.
demo.trap: The software block below is absent rather than zeroed. A loot Item that carries an empty software block is not wrong, but it reads as a program with no computer; leaving it out says what this is.

system.description: Four charged cells in an oilcloth roll. Fits the lamp, the beacon and the sidearm's sight.
